cadre: Design studio “Building in solid stone”: D. Vielfaure, S. Gasnier
texte: The project brings residents, visitors and artists together around a place of creation and sharing. The plot is organised into two buildings that share their circulation, creating a planted central courtyard and a passage linking the two streets. Set along the quays, the project houses a painting café and shared homes for painters. Built in solid stone, it works on the thickness of the walls and on the façade, with arches on the ground floor and window sills shaped as inverted arches.
experimentation: As part of the project, a full-scale experiment in solid stone made it possible to study the constructive principles of the material: joints, spans and ways of building. The project's construction detail was then carved in stone with hand tools such as the saw, the hammer and the chisel. This experiment led to the inverted-arch window sill, with an upstand and a reworked shape to drain rainwater, testing the drawing against the reality of construction.
